prompt: A manufacturing plant operates 5 days a week, 8 hours a day, producing 150 widgets per hour. Quality control indicates that 8% of the produced widgets are defective. Of these defective widgets, 60% can be repaired at a cost of $7.50 each. The remaining defective widgets are discarded, and each discarded widget must be replaced by a newly manufactured one at a cost of $12.00. The plant aims to deliver 5000 non-defective widgets per week. What is the total additional cost incurred per week due to defective widgets (including both repair and replacement costs)?
